note: Declared decision levels the desk evaluates. Hand-maintained, never generated: a trigger enters this file when its owner declares it in so many words, and its provenance travels with it. Levels here are DATA the desk reads — changing one is a declaration event, not an edit. The LP price triggers are declared in POOL TICKS, which are fixed and single-sourced from slot0(); the USD versions quoted before 2026-09-14 had two moving parts (PONS/WETH and ETH/USD) and were stale the moment ETH moved — 'floor $0.408' was only true at ETH $2,480.

triggers.subject: PONS/WETH 0.3% pool 0xEd50bDeeA8aDC232f159486192a4157281D722ff, Robinhood Chain (4663)
triggers.unit: pool tick (rising tick = falling PONS; 87000 is the position's upper tick = its price floor)
triggers.declared_by: trading session, relayed by Mitchell in chat; redeclared in ticks 2026-09-14 replacing the same-day $0.408 USD form
triggers.on_breach: Floor: the position is out of range on the low-price side and the thesis is off. The trading session decides; the desk only reports the crossing.
triggers.source_required: wired: eth_call slot0() on the pool by address, DESK_RPC_URL or the public Robinhood Chain RPC. A transport failure renders as attempted-and-failed, which is a different fact from unwired.

triggers.subject: PONS/WETH 0.3% pool 0xEd50bDeeA8aDC232f159486192a4157281D722ff, Robinhood Chain (4663)
triggers.unit: pool tick (85% of the way from 77640 to 87000, toward the floor)
triggers.declared_by: trading session, declared directly in ticks, relayed by Mitchell in chat
triggers.on_breach: Review: 15% of range remains before the position is all-PONS and stops earning. Re-examine, do not auto-act.
triggers.source_required: wired: same slot0() read as pons-floor.
triggers.derivation: 85% through the range: 77640 + 0.85 x (87000 - 77640) = 85596. Declared in the unit that cannot drift, with the rationale attached (15% of range left before the position stops earning).

superseded.why_retired: A PONS/USD level has two moving parts (PONS/WETH and ETH/USD) and was quoted around a stale ETH for a week — never declared in a stable unit.

The site's arithmetic translation of the $0.455 figure at that day's ETH. Checking it exposed that the trading session's OWN monitor (scripts/lp_range_check.sh) had been firing on a different rule the whole time — pos > 85% of range, which is tick 85596, a 443-tick / ~4.5% gap. Two statements of one trigger disagreed and neither side was reading the other. The range-fraction rule is the one that was actually watching the position and the one with a stated rationale, so it governs; the dollar figure and its translation are both retired.

triggers.subject: Uniswap v3 position #1109566, PONS/WETH 0.3%, ticks 77640-87000
triggers.unit: % of position value per day, fee yield on ACTIVE liquidity
triggers.declared_by: trading session, relayed by Mitchell in chat
triggers.on_breach: Falsifier: fee yield sustained under 0.25%/day across three consecutive readings kills the LP thesis. Three readings, not one — a single quiet window is weather.
triggers.source_required: fee-yield readings require parsing Swap events against active liquidity (the TVL-based figure is refused by construction — it is the metric that misled the book for three days). The pool address is now known; the remaining blocker is the log scan itself: the public RPC caps eth_getLogs at 10,000 events, so the reader needs windowed scans or a better endpoint via DESK_RPC_URL.
